mainEntity.name: What software solutions does UX Hub provide for e-commerce?

acceptedAnswer.text: UX Hub provides Pricing Super Intelligence, an automated competitor price tracking, SKU matching, and dynamic repricing platform for brands across Amazon, Noon, Trendyol, Jarir, and e-commerce websites in India, Saudi Arabia, and the GCC.

mainEntity.name: In which regions does UX Hub operate?

acceptedAnswer.text: UX Hub operates across the India and Saudi Arabia (KSA) corridor, serving clients across India, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, and globally.
